ddl.value: ("resource_type" IS NULL AND "resource_id" IS NULL) OR ("resource_type" IS NOT NULL AND "resource_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: organization_events_resource_pair_check

ddl.value:
(
        "purpose" = 'magic-link-signin'
        AND "token_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "code_hmac" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "purpose" = 'passkey-registration'
        AND "token_hash" IS NULL
        AND "code_hmac" IS NULL
      )
ddl.name: verification_purpose_fields_check

ddl.value: ("type" = 'access' AND "family_id" IS NULL AND "parent_id" IS NULL AND "consumed_at" IS NULL) OR ("type" = 'refresh' AND "family_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: oauth_token_shape_check

ddl.value:
(
        ("system_role_id" IS NOT NULL AND "key" IS NULL AND "metadata" IS NULL AND "permissions" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("system_role_id" IS NULL AND "key" IS NOT NULL AND "metadata" IS NOT NULL AND "permissions" IS NOT NULL)
      )
ddl.name: organization_role_source_check

ddl.value: "system_role_id" IS NOT NULL OR "key" NOT IN ('owner', 'admin', 'member')
ddl.name: organization_role_custom_key_not_system_check

ddl.value: ("provider" IS NULL AND "provider_customer_id" IS NULL) OR ("provider" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_customer_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: billing_account_provider_customer_check

ddl.value: ("status" = 'open' AND "closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'closed' AND "closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: billing_period_lifecycle_check

ddl.value: ("current_period_start" IS NULL AND "current_period_end" IS NULL) OR ("current_period_start" IS NOT NULL AND "current_period_end" IS NOT NULL AND "current_period_end" > "current_period_start")
ddl.name: billing_subscription_period_check

ddl.value: ("provider" IS NULL AND "provider_subscription_id" IS NULL) OR ("provider" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_subscription_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: billing_subscription_provider_check

ddl.value: ("billing_mode" = 'licensed' AND "quantity" IS NOT NULL AND "quantity" >= 0) OR ("billing_mode" = 'metered' AND "quantity" IS NULL)
ddl.name: billing_subscription_item_mode_quantity_check

ddl.value: ("status" = 'active' AND "removed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'removed' AND "removed_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: billing_subscription_item_lifecycle_check

ddl.value: ("status" = 'delivered' AND "delivered_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" IN ('pending', 'retrying', 'failed') AND "delivered_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: billing_usage_delivery_lifecycle_check

ddl.value: ("direction" = 'debit' AND "reverses_usage_event_id" IS NULL) OR ("direction" = 'credit' AND "reverses_usage_event_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: billing_usage_event_reversal_check

ddl.value: ("status" = 'active' AND "settled_at" IS NULL AND "released_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'settled' AND "settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "released_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" IN ('released', 'expired') AND "settled_at" IS NULL AND "released_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: billing_usage_reservation_lifecycle_check

ddl.value:
("status" IN ('revoking', 'revoked')) = ("revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
      AND ("revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("revoked_by_actor_id" IS NULL)
ddl.name: session_key_revocation_check

ddl.value:
("status" NOT IN ('submitted', 'installed', 'revoking', 'revoked') OR "install_user_operation_hash" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("status" NOT IN ('installed', 'revoking', 'revoked') OR ("install_transaction_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "installed_at" IS NOT NULL))
    AND ("status" <> 'revoked' OR ("uninstall_user_operation_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "uninstall_transaction_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "revoked_at" IS NOT NULL))
ddl.name: session_installation_receipt_check

ddl.value:
CASE WHEN "status" IN ('awaiting-signature', 'expired')
      THEN COALESCE("data"->'signed' = 'null'::jsonb, false)
      ELSE COALESCE(jsonb_typeof("data"->'signed') = 'object', false)
    END
ddl.name: session_operation_signature_state_check

ddl.value:
("status" IN ('confirmed', 'failed')) = ("transaction_hash" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("status" IN ('confirmed', 'failed', 'expired')) = ("finished_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: session_operation_receipt_check

ddl.value:
("lease_token" IS NULL OR "lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("status" IN ('signed', 'submitted') OR ("lease_token" IS NULL AND "lease_expires_at" IS NULL))
ddl.name: session_operation_lease_check

ddl.value: ("status" = 'reserved' AND "failure_code" IS NULL AND "succeeded_at" IS NULL AND "failed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'succeeded' AND "failure_code" IS NULL AND "succeeded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "failed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'failed' AND "failure_code" IS NOT NULL AND "succeeded_at" IS NULL AND "failed_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: signature_operation_lifecycle_check

ddl.value: "actor_id" IS NULL OR "organization_id" IS NOT NULL
ddl.name: notifications_actor_organization_check
